title: b7z9.37.3(i): RootSeqCache module in lichen-rpl (replay + wrap fail-closed)
description: Parent: project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.37.3 (spec/06-security.md:668,687). Standalone rust/lichen-rpl/src/root_seq_cache.rs: RootSeqCache keyed by (dodag_id [u8;16], instance u8); accept(record) only when root_seq strictly greater than the cached value for that key (equal-or-lower = replay; any non-increase also enforces the MUST-NOT-WRAP rule since a post-wrap counter appears lower); missing key = first observation, accepted. Follow lichen-rpl crate conventions (see dao_timing.rs/table.rs for collection style; check no_std posture of siblings). Unit tests: replay of equal seq rejected, lower rejected, post-wrap lower rejected, per-(dodag_id,instance) isolation, first-observation accepted, distinct instances independent. No wiring — sibling (ii) integrates into RplStack; child .1 consumes at receiver validation.
